certainty: Words EMPTY (isolated-sign item, per the KN Zb 36a-d precedent): after autopsy Olivier reads the sinistroverse sequence of syllabogram AB 04 (TE) and klasmatogram A 708 (K), or alternatively a single ligature of the two ('04'+'708'), which he proposes to insert in the LA sign table as A 505bis. His earlier reading (arithmogram + klasmatogram + isolated syllabogram, Rapport 1991-1995) is withdrawn: the 'arithmogram' is a control mark. Klasmatograms and control marks are kept out of words.
source: Del Freo, Rapport 2001-2005, Colloquium Romanum (Pasiphae I), 2008, pp. 208-209 (received from M. Del Freo 2026-08-10, corpus/bronze/delfreo_rapports_pre2016/, sha 7ebba45a...); primary: CMS V Suppl. 1B (1993), cf. CHIC #137
notes: Nodulus, ex SA We 1 (= CHIC #137), renumbered We 3 because the two anepigraphic roundels {SA Wc 1}/{SA Wc 2} were assigned numbers 1-2; MM II-III. A 708 is EXCLUSIVE to Linear A, which also supports the LA attribution of the twin nodulus SA We 4. Absent from the silver corpus (silver holds only SAMWa1 for Samothrace).
